daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿طسم﴾ has no grammatical position. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمُبِينِ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ﴾ لعل, its noun and its khabar. ﴿نَفْسَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of باخع. ﴿أَلَّا﴾ أن is accusative-governing and لا is negating. ﴿يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun and its khabar; أن and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَشَأْ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial. ﴿نُنَزِّلْ﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ننزل. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿آيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿فَظَلَّتْ أَعْناقُهُمْ لَها خاضِعِينَ﴾ ظل, its noun and its khabar; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خاضعين, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause after it is conjoined to what precedes it; ما is negating. ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi placed first. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ذِكْرٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of يأتيهم. ﴿مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to an adjective of ذكر. ﴿مُحْدَثٍ﴾ an adjective of ذكر. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ kāna, the wāw being its noun and معرضين its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to معرضين; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:6-9.t: ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنْبؤُا﴾ an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause كانوا يستهزئون is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is resumptive, and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿يَرَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to يروا. ﴿كَمْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi placed first; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْبَتْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause stands in place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to أنبتنا. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿زَوْجٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَرِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to the khabar placed first. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the noun of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾ the shifted lām. ﴿هو﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ the khabar of هو; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:10-14.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر). ﴿نادى رَبُّكَ مُوسى﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنِ﴾ explicative. ﴿ائْتِ﴾ an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative; and ﴿قَوْمَ﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the preceding القوم. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, accusative by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. [Translator's note: so in the source, «منصوب»; as muḍāf ilayhi it is genitive (majrūr), marked by the fatḥa in place of the kasra.] ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of gentle proposal (ʿarḍ). ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, with an omitted vocative particle; the clause after it is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يُكَذِّبُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person was dropped to keep the verse-endings (fawāṣil). ﴿وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسانِي﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَأَرْسِلْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and أرسل is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى هارُونَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لهم is attached to the khabar placed first. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ attached to the khabar placed first. ﴿ذَنْبٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَخافُ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يَقْتُلُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection, and the dropped yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:15-18.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of deterrence (radʿ). ﴿فَاذْهَبا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, joining to the omitted clause, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is the alif. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذهبا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ﴾ inna is a particle resembling the verb, نا is its noun, معكما is an adverb attached to مستمعون, and مستمعون is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: the source prints «معكما» while the verse has مَعَكُمْ.] ﴿فَأْتِيا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَقُولا﴾ an imperative indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is its fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّا رَسُولُ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the clause is the object of the speech. [Translator's note: in the source text the bracketing of the words from فَأْتِيا to الْعالَمِينَ is damaged; the Quranic words have been restored from the verse without changing the analysis.] ﴿أَنْ﴾ an explicative particle. ﴿أَرْسِلْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place, attached to أرسل, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَنِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause is explicative with no grammatical position. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿نُرَبِّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِينا﴾ attached to نربك. ﴿وَلِيداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَبِثْتَ فِينا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ عُمُرِكَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ an adverb of time; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:19-22.t: ﴿وَفَعَلْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَعْلَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, adjective (naʿt). ﴿فَعَلْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and أنت is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَعَلْتُها﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response. ﴿وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَفَرَرْتُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ attached to فررت. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ an adverb of time, being the temporal لمّا (al-ḥīniyya). ﴿خِفْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَوَهَبَ﴾ conjoined to ففررت. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to وهب. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَجَعَلَنِي﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ attached to جعل, and the two stand in for its second object. ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and تلك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿نِعْمَةٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَمُنُّها﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective of نعمة. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ attached to تمنها. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. ﴿عَبَّدْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَنِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, from أن and what follows it, is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

daas-irab:23-27.t: ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ a resumptive clause. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبُّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "he" (هو). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَما﴾ ما is a relative noun conjoined to السموات. ﴿بَيْنَهُمَا﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then believe in Him alone, who has no partner". ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال. ﴿حَوْلَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿تَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾ and the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He is your Lord" (هو ربكم). ﴿وَرَبُّ﴾ conjoined to ربكم; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿آبائِكُمُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of آبائكم. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ an adjective. ﴿أُرْسِلَ﴾ a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to أرسل. ﴿لَمَجْنُونٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مجنون is the khabar of inna; the clause is the object of the speech.

daas-irab:28-31.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْمَشْرِقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْمَغْرِبِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المشرق; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is a relative, conjoined to المشرق. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar, and the clause كنتم etc. is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنِ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional. ﴿اتَّخَذْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلهَاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غَيْرِي﴾ an adjective (naʿt), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ﴾ the lām is that of the answer to the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أجعلنك; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath, and the apodosis clause (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is circumstantial, and لو is conditional. ﴿جِئْتُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾ attached to جئتك. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective of شيء; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and ائت is an imperative indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to ائت. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun, and it is the protasis. ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:32-36.t: ﴿فَأَلْقى﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَصاهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هِيَ ثُعْبانٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذا هِيَ بَيْضاءُ﴾ the clause is conjoined to ألقى etc. ﴿لِلنَّاظِرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بيضاء. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلْمَلَإِ﴾ attached to قال. ﴿حَوْلَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ هذا لَساحِرٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted; أن and the imperfect verb after it are an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), mafʿūl bihi of يريد; and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source, «فاعله محذوف»; the fāʿil of يريد is a latent pronoun.] ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾ ﴿بِسِحْرِهِ﴾ the two prepositions with their genitive nouns are attached to يخرجكم, and the clause يريد is an adjective of ساحر. ﴿فَماذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and ذا is a relative noun, khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَأْمُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْجِهْ﴾ an imperative indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَأَخاهُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and أخاه is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَابْعَثْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْمَدائِنِ﴾ attached to ابعث. ﴿حاشِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:37-41.t: ﴿يَأْتُوكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوك. ﴿سَحَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لِمِيقاتِ﴾ attached to جمع. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَعْلُومٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ attached to قيل. ﴿هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ﴾ هل is an interrogative particle, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَعَلَّنا﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ﴾ an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of لعل. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كانُوا هُمُ الْغالِبِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; هم is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; the clause كانوا.. is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position, and the apodosis clause (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the context indicates it, its implied form being "then we follow them". ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and لمّا means "when". ﴿جاءَ السَّحَرَةُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition with no grammatical position. ﴿لِفِرْعَوْنَ﴾ attached to قالوا. ﴿أَإِنَّ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to the omitted khabar of inna. ﴿لَأَجْراً﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ), and أجرا is the noun of inna placed later; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ conditional. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.] ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a separating pronoun with no grammatical position. ﴿الْغالِبِينَ﴾ the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:42-45.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعَمْ﴾ a particle of response. ﴿وَإِنَّكُمْ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response. ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ مُوسى﴾ a past verb and fāʿil (agent), and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to قال; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾ an imperative and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَأَلْقَوْا حِبالَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَعِصِيَّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to حبالهم; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِعِزَّةِ﴾ attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "we swear" (نحلف). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَنَحْنُ﴾ the shifted lām, and نحن is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: so in the source; the following words treat نحن as the mubtadaʾ.] ﴿الْغالِبُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿فَأَلْقى مُوسى عَصاهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَلْقَفُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of هي. ﴿يَأْفِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:46-49.t: ﴿فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ ساجِدِينَ﴾ a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and ساجدين is ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) for رب. ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهارُونَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to موسى. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to آمنتم. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to آمنتم. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿آذَنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to آذن; أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, adjective (naʿt). ﴿عَلَّمَكُمُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السِّحْرَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَلَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and سوف is for the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the clause is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ﴾ the lām is for the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿مِنْ خِلافٍ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to لأقطعن. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf, accusative.

daas-irab:50-54.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا ضَيْرَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation, ضير is its noun, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "upon us" (علينا). ﴿إِنَّا إِلى رَبِّنا مُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ inna, and نا is its noun, and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿نَطْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿أَنْ يَغْفِرَ﴾ أن is accusative-governing and the imperfect verb is accusative. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to يغفر. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾ fāʿil, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَطايانا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), is accusative by removal of the preposition, the implied form being "for the forgiving" (بغفران). ﴿أَنْ﴾ maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya). ﴿كُنَّا أَوَّلَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ attached to أوحينا. ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative. ﴿أَسْرِ﴾ an imperative indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِعِبادِي﴾ attached to أسر; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is causal. ﴿فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدائِنِ حاشِرِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أرسل. ﴿إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿لَشِرْذِمَةٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and شرذمة is the khabar. ﴿قَلِيلُونَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is the object of an omitted saying.

daas-irab:55-61.t:
﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) after it. ﴿لَغائِظُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar of inna; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun, and the shifted lām, and جميع is a first khabar. ﴿حاذِرُونَ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْناهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ﴾ attached to أخرجناهم. ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined to جنات. ﴿وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقامٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿كَرِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of مقام. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the matter is thus" (الأمر كذلك), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it.
﴿وَأَوْرَثْناها﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَنِي﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what went before. ﴿فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُشْرِقِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿تَراءَا الْجَمْعانِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ أَصْحابُ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:62-68.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of rebuke (zajr). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿مَعِي﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the noun of inna, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿سَيَهْدِينِ﴾ the clause is resumptive; the imperfect verb is nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the dropped yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أوحينا. ﴿أَنِ﴾ explicative. ﴿اضْرِبْ بِعَصاكَ الْبَحْرَ﴾ an imperative, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اضرب; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿فَانْفَلَقَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, its implied form being "so he struck, and it split" (فضرب فانفلق). ﴿فَكانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ﴾ kāna and its noun, and فرق is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ attached to the khabar, and العظيم is an adjective (naʿt); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَزْلَفْنا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and ثمّ is an adverb meaning "there"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْجَيْنا مُوسى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to موسى. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to something omitted, the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of من. ﴿ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the noun of inna. ﴿وَما كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, ما is negating, and kāna is defective (nāqiṣa), with its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ see the i'rab of verse no. 9.

daas-irab:69-74.t: ﴿وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ an imperative indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and نبأ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتل, and إبراهيم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ attached to قال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقَوْمِهِ﴾ conjoined to أبيه. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, a mafʿūl bihi placed first. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعْبُدُ أَصْناماً﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿فَنَظَلُّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿لَها﴾ attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عاكِفِينَ﴾ khabar. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يسمعون. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to يسمعونكم. ﴿أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what went before. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿آباءَنا﴾ first mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is mafʿūl bihi of يفعلون and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the second mafʿūl bihi of وجدنا.

daas-irab:75-81.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in تعبدون. ﴿وَآباؤُكُمُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أنتم. ﴿الْأَقْدَمُونَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of آباؤكم. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ﴾ the fāʾ is causal, and inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿لِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; the clause is a causal explanation of what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿رَبَّ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a badal (substitute) for رب. ﴿خَلَقَنِي﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِينِ﴾ the clause is the khabar; the yāʾ of the first person was dropped to keep the verse-endings (fawāṣil). ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ conjoined to the الذي before it. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يُطْعِمُنِي﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَيَسْقِينِ﴾ the clause is conjoined to يطعمني. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَرِضْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause after it has no grammatical position; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشْفِينِ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the nūn is for protection; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يُمِيتُنِي﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُحْيِينِ﴾ the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:82-89.t: ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَطْمَعُ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي﴾ أن is accusative-governing, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿لِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغفر. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb attached to يغفر. ﴿الدِّينِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā). ﴿هَبْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to هب. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَلْحِقْنِي﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to هب. ﴿بِالصَّالِحِينَ﴾ attached to ألحقني. ﴿وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسانَ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent, and its first object; لي is attached to اجعل. ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ attached to اجعل; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاجْعَلْنِي﴾ the clause is conjoined to what went before. ﴿مِنْ وَرَثَةِ﴾ attached to اجعلني. ﴿جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and النعيم is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاغْفِرْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what went before. ﴿لِأَبِي﴾ attached to اغفر, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is a causal explanation of what precedes. ﴿كانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ﴾ kāna, its noun omitted, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُخْزِنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb attached to تخزني. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) for the first يوم. ﴿لا يَنْفَعُ مالٌ﴾ لا is negating; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا بَنُونَ﴾ conjoined to what went before. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿أَتَى اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِقَلْبٍ﴾ attached to أتى. ﴿سَلِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt).

daas-irab:90-96.t: ﴿وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the past verb is passive, and الجنة is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to لا ينفع مال. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أزلفت. ﴿وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ﴾ the clause is conjoined to أزلفت. ﴿لِلْغاوِينَ﴾ attached to برزت. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the verb is passive; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; أين and what follows it are in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil of قيل. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to تعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْصُرُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَنْتَصِرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to ينصرونكم. ﴿فَكُبْكِبُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, the past verb is passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to كبكبوا; the meaning is "they were thrown into it on their faces". ﴿هُمْ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿وَالْغاوُونَ﴾ conjoined to the wāw of the plural. ﴿وَجُنُودُ﴾ conjoined to the wāw of the plural. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw of the plural and what is conjoined to it. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿هُمْ فِيها يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:97-103.t: ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, "we swear" (نقسم), and the oath clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy (inna), and inoperative (muhmala). ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿لَفِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the lām distinguishing between negation and affirmation (al-lām al-fāriqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of ضلال; the clause is the answer to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to مبين. ﴿نُسَوِّيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ attached to نسويكم. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿أَضَلَّنا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first and a fāʿil placed later, and إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شافِعِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form by the yāʾ, nominative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant, for emphasizing the negation. ﴿صَدِيقٍ﴾ conjoined to شافعين in form. ﴿حَمِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of صديق. ﴿فَلَوْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and لو is for wishing (tamannī). ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿كَرَّةً﴾ its noun, placed later. ﴿فَنَكُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is causative (al-sababiyya), and the clause, from أن and the verb, is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to كرة. ﴿فَنَكُونَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the causative fāʾ, its noun a latent pronoun, and ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ is attached to the khabar. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾ inna is a particle resembling the verb; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a khabar placed first; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is its noun. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:104-109.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and العزيز الرحيم are the two predicates of inna. ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِذْ﴾ the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبت. ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is one of the five nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ a badal (substitute) for أخوهم. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of gentle proposal (ʿarḍ). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رسول. ﴿أَمِينٌ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to فاتقوا; an imperative, the wāw is its fāʿil, and the dropped yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to أسألكم. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَجْرٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَجْرِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلى رَبِّ﴾ attached to the khabar. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:110-115.t: ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, its implied form being "if the matter is so, then fear Allah". ﴿وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ an imperative, the wāw is its fāʿil and the dropped yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to فاتقوا. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنُؤْمِنُ﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَكَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نؤمن. ﴿وَاتَّبَعَكَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and a past verb and its object. ﴿الْأَرْذَلُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عِلْمِي﴾ the khabar (predicate) of ما, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to علمي. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿حِسابُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلى رَبِّي﴾ attached to the khabar, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like laysa. ﴿أَنَا﴾ its noun. ﴿بِطارِدِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and طارد is genitive in form, nominative in position, the khabar of ما. [Translator's note: so in the source, «مرفوع محلا»; the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ما is accusative in position, as the source itself says at verse 138.] ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation of the negation.

daas-irab:116-119.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam) and إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-governing. ﴿تَنْتَهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يا نُوحُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with يا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿لَتَكُونَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and تكون is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of تكون; the clause answering the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed. ﴿إِنَّ قَوْمِي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَذَّبُونِ﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil, the dropped yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿فَافْتَحْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb attached to افتح. ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَنَجِّنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿مَعِيَ﴾ an adverb, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the adverb is attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ attached to something omitted, the ṣila of من. ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to the hāʾ of أنجيناه. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿فِي الْفُلْكِ﴾ attached to أنجيناه. ﴿الْمَشْحُونِ﴾ an adjective (naʿt).

daas-irab:120-127.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَغْرَقْنا بَعْدُ الْباقِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بعد is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) أغرقنا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾ inna; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate), آية is the noun of inna, and the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ). ﴿وَما كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, ما is negating, and kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two predicates; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَذَّبَتْ عادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to كذبت. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to قال. ﴿أَخُوهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُودٌ﴾ a badal (substitute) for أخوهم. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of urging (ḥaḍḍ). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and أمين is an adjective (naʿt); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ see verse 110. ﴿وَما أَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلى رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ see verse 109.

daas-irab:128-131.t: ﴿أَتَبْنُونَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تبنون. ﴿رِيعٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعْبَثُونَ﴾ the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَتَتَّخِذُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مَصانِعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿تَخْلُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿بَطَشْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi; and the second clause ﴿بَطَشْتُمْ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and جبارين is ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:132-135.t: ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَمَدَّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمدكم. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَمَدَّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the fāʿil latent; the clause is a badal (substitute) for the first أمدكم. ﴿بِأَنْعامٍ﴾ attached to أمدكم. ﴿وَبَنِينَ﴾ conjoined to أنعام, and it is genitive by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَجَنَّاتٍ﴾ conjoined to what went before. ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined to جنات. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to أخاف. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt).

daas-irab:136-145.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾ a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) سواء. ﴿أَوَعَظْتَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-governing. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْواعِظِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar of تكن; the hamza of equivalence (taswiya) and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later. ﴿إِنْ هذا﴾ إن is negating and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خُلُقُ﴾ the khabar of هذا. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ the noun of ما. ﴿بِمُعَذَّبِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and معذبين is a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما. ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to the khabar placed first. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the noun of inna. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded shortly before. ﴿كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿إِذْ قالَ لَهُمْ﴾ the i'rab of this verse and those after it up to verse 145 has preceded.

daas-irab:146-146.t: ﴿أَتُتْرَكُونَ﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and a passive imperfect verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي ما﴾ the preposition and the genitive relative noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتركون. ﴿هاهُنا﴾ the hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is an adverb of place attached to something omitted, the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative by the yāʾ.

daas-irab:147-154.t: ﴿فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) for His words فيما هاهنا. ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جنات. ﴿وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿طَلْعُها هَضِيمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is an adjective (naʿt) of نخل. ﴿وَتَنْحِتُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to تتركون. ﴿مِنَ الْجِبالِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنحتون. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فارِهِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ see verse 108. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُطِيعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, adjective of المسرفين. ﴿يُفْسِدُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to يفسدون. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يُصْلِحُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to يفسدون. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa). ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِثْلُنا﴾ an adjective, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأْتِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ attached to the verb before it; the clause ائت is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar.

daas-irab:155-159.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذِهِ ناقَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar placed first. ﴿شِرْبٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ placed later; the clause is an adjective (naʿt). ﴿وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ placed later, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to a khabar placed first; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَعْلُومٍ﴾ an adjective of يوم. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَمَسُّوها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾ attached to تمسوها; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ﴾ the causative fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya); يأخذكم is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the causative fāʾ, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَذابُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ an adjective; أن and the verb, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding verb, its implied form being "let there be no touching of the she-camel by you, lest there be your seizing by a punishment". ﴿فَعَقَرُوها﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا نادِمِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أصبح and its noun, and نادمين is its khabar. ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ a past verb, its object placed first and its fāʿil placed later; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾ inna, the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), آية is its noun, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted khabar; see the i'rab of verse 8. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾ the shifted lām, and هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:160-166.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and لوط is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ قالَ﴾ the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa) to the adverb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿أَخُوهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لُوطٌ﴾ a badal (substitute) for أخوهم. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the i'rab of verse 162 is the i'rab of verse 107, the i'rab of verse 163 is the i'rab of verse 108, and the i'rab of verse 164 is the i'rab of verse 109. ﴿أَتَأْتُونَ﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the imperfect verb is nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الذُّكْرانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذكران; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿وَتَذَرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to خلق. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ أَزْواجِكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿عادُونَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt), nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:167-173.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam) and إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-governing. ﴿تَنْتَهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يا لُوطُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with يا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿لَتَكُونَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and تكون is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of تكون; the clause answering the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لِعَمَلِكُمْ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْقالِينَ﴾ attached to an adjective of the omitted khabar; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle; it is muḍāf, and the dropped yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نَجِّنِي﴾ a verb of supplication indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, the fāʿil latent, and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿وَأَهْلِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أهلي is conjoined to the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ من is a preposition and the relative ما is in the position of genitive by من; the two are attached to نجني. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أهله is conjoined to the accusative pronoun in نجيناه. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the accusative pronoun and what is conjoined to it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عَجُوزاً﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْغابِرِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of عجوزا. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَراً﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَساءَ مَطَرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:174-177.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ..﴾ its i'rab has preceded at verse 103. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ..﴾ refer to verse 145. ﴿كَذَّبَ أَصْحابُ الْأَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الأيكة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذب. ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to قال; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:178-182.t: The i'rab of the three verses has preceded; see verses 107, 108 and 109. ﴿أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ﴾ an imperative, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا تَكُونُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive; تكونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَزِنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source, «ماض»; زِنُوا is an imperative.] ﴿بِالْقِسْطاسِ﴾ attached to زنوا. ﴿الْمُسْتَقِيمِ﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of القسطاس; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:183-187.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْخَسُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَشْياءَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تعثوا. ﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي﴾ an imperative, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْجِبِلَّةَ﴾ conjoined to the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ ما is negating. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مِثْلُنا﴾ an adjective, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and إن is lightened from the heavy (inna), without effect. ﴿نَظُنُّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لَمِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾ attached to the verb, the two being its second object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَسْقِطْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and أسقط is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to أسقط. ﴿كِسَفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of كسفا. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause فأسقط etc. is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:188-196.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذابُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi placed first and a fāʿil placed later. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الظُّلَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانَ عَذابَ﴾ kāna, its noun omitted, and عذاب is its khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi and an adjective (naʿt) qualifying it. For the i'rab of verses 190 and 191, see the i'rab of verses 8 and 9. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنْزِيلُ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to نزل. ﴿الْأَمِينُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿عَلى قَلْبِكَ﴾ attached to نزل. ﴿لِتَكُونَ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; إن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to نزل; the noun of تكون is necessarily omitted. [Translator's note: the source writes «وإن»; the implied particle is أن.] ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar of تكون. ﴿بِلِسانٍ﴾ attached to نزل. ﴿عَرَبِيٍّ﴾ an adjective. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and inna and its noun. ﴿لَفِي زُبُرِ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the khabar of inna. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:197-201.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), the wāw is resumptive, and لم is a particle of negation, jussive government and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿يَكُنْ لَهُمْ آيَةً﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its khabar (predicate), and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from آية. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَماءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, its object placed first and its fāʿil (agent) placed later; أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of nominative as the noun of يكن. ﴿بَنِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and لو is conditional, non-jussive. ﴿نَزَّلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى بَعْضِ﴾ attached to نزلناه. ﴿الْأَعْجَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقَرَأَهُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to قرأه. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to مؤمنين. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ khabar; the clause is the apodosis of لولا with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: «لولا» in the source is evidently «لو لا», i.e. "the apodosis of لو, with no grammatical position".] ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿سَلَكْناهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾ attached to سلكناه. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to يؤمنون. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَرَوُا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَلِيمَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar, are genitive by حتى, and the two are attached to what precedes them.

daas-irab:202-207.t: ﴿فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an accusative imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم. ﴿فَيَقُولُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the imperfect verb is conjoined to يأتيهم and accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَفَبِعَذابِنا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and wonder, the fāʾ is resumptive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستعجلون, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative and the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿مَتَّعْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to متعناهم. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil of جاءهم. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿يُوعَدُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of kāna; a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, the second being omitted; the clause كانوا يوعدون has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ما﴾ a mafʿūl bihi of أغنى, placed first. ﴿أَغْنى﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ attached to أغنى. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil of أغنى. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿يُمَتَّعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause يمتعون is the khabar of كانوا, the clause كانوا is the ṣila, and the clause ما أغنى etc. is the second mafʿūl bihi of رأيت, the first object being a latent pronoun.

daas-irab:208-213.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لَها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مُنْذِرُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the clause is an adjective (naʿt) of قرية. ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "it is a reminder" (هو ذكرى), the clause being parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and ما is negating. ﴿كُنَّا ظالِمِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّياطِينُ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to تنزلت; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿يَنْبَغِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to ينبغي; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined; an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, its object omitted, its implied form being "that" (ذلك). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ﴾ inna and its noun, the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition) and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَدْعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلهاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آخَرَ﴾ an adjective; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت). ﴿مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar.

daas-irab:214-220.t: ﴿وَأَنْذِرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَشِيرَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الْأَقْرَبِينَ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿وَاخْفِضْ جَناحَكَ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, جناحك is its object, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ من is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اخفض. ﴿اتَّبَعَكَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿عَصَوْكَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the fāʾ is the connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ من is a preposition and من is a relative, and [the two] are attached to بريء. [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative here is ما.] ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ﴾ attached to توكل. ﴿الرَّحِيمِ﴾ an adjective of العزيز; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, an adjective of العزيز. ﴿يَراكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and its object; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). [Translator's note: so in the source; as the clause following الذي it would ordinarily be the ṣila.] ﴿حِينَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يراك. ﴿تَقُومُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَقَلُّبَكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [it is] conjoined to the kāf in يراك, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿السَّمِيعُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ a second khabar of إنه; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:221-226.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿أُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and its object; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ من is an interrogative noun; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنزل. ﴿تَنَزَّلُ الشَّياطِينُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause stands in place of the second and third objects of أنبئكم. ﴿تَنَزَّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ attached to تنزل. ﴿أَفَّاكٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); it means "the liar". ﴿أَثِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is a badal (substitute) for the preceding تنزل. ﴿يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كاذِبُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَالشُّعَراءُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغاوُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its object placed first and its fāʿil placed later; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī), and لم is a particle of negation, jussive government and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun; the clause stands in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾ attached to يهيمون. ﴿وادٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَهِيمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿وَأَنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and anna and its noun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of anna, and the clause أنهم is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:227-227.t:
﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, in the position of accusative. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the kasra; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to آمنوا. ﴿وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "much remembrance"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَانْتَصَرُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) انتصروا. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya). ﴿ظُلِمُوا﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause, from ما and the verb, is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the annexation of بعد to it. ﴿وَسَيَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ظُلِمُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿ظُلِمُوا﴾ here; the word in the verse is ظَلَمُوا (active), as the analysis "past verb and fāʿil" indicates.] ﴿أَيَّ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿مُنْقَلَبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause stands in place of the two objects of سيعلم. Allah had censured the poets in this sura, so the poets of the Prophet ﷺ, Kaʿb ibn Mālik, ʿAbd الله ibn Rawāḥa and Ḥassān ibn Thābit, may Allah be pleased with them, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ weeping, and said: "O Prophet of Allah, Allah has sent down this verse: والشعراء يتبعهم الغاوون." He said to them: "Read what comes after it: إلا الذين آمنوا.."
And they rejoiced at the revelation of this verse, which excepted the believers.
